name: Apartmen am Waldrand
beschreibung:
=== description ===

The Apartment Am Waldrand is located at the edge of Langkampfen in the Tiroler Unterland. The area is characterized by meadows and the surrounding forest, offering a peaceful setting outside the village center. Guests can reach the heart of Langkampfen in just a few minutes by car or on foot. The apartment is well-equipped with a kitchen, a bedroom, and a balcony. Parking spaces are available directly on the property.
